name: WPB Product Size Chart Popup for WooCommerce – Improve Fit & Reduce Returns
author: WPBean

sections.description:
WPB Product Size Chart Popup for WooCommerce is a powerful and user-friendly solution to help customers choose the right product size with confidence. This WooCommerce size chart plugin lets you add clear, well-structured size chart tables to product pages, improving user experience and helping reduce size-related returns.

With flexible display options, you can show the size chart as a popup for a clean, distraction-free layout. The popup can be triggered via Elementor widget, shortcode, or product tabs, making the size guide easily accessible without cluttering your product pages.

The plugin includes an advanced size chart table builder, allowing you to create, edit, and manage multiple size charts effortlessly. Assign different size charts to specific products, categories, or product types, giving you full control based on your store requirements.

You also get complete customization of the size chart button, including text, color, size, and position—ensuring it perfectly matches your WooCommerce store design while staying visible and easy to use.

Live Demo | Documentation | Upgrade to Pro!

Why is a Size Chart Plugin Essential for WooCommerce?

  • Reduce Returns & Exchanges – Accurate size charts help customers select the correct size, minimizing returns.

  • Improve Customer Experience – Clear sizing information leads to better purchase satisfaction.

  • Increase Conversion Rates – Confident buyers are more likely to complete their purchase.

  • Build Trust & Credibility – Detailed size guides show professionalism and reliability.

  • Lower Support Requests – Reduce customer queries related to sizing issues.

  • Boost Customer Loyalty – Positive fit experiences encourage repeat purchases.

  • Support Global Customers – Include international size conversions for worldwide shoppers.

  • Enable Smarter Buying Decisions – Help users make informed choices with less hesitation.

WooCommerce Size Chart Key Features:

  • Create unlimited size charts for your WooCommerce product size guide.
  • Built-in size chart table builder (up to 3 columns and 5 rows).
  • Assign size charts to specific products and product categories.
  • Display size charts in a popup or product tabs.
  • Flexible button placement settings for better visibility.
  • Easy size chart content customization options.
  • Simple setup with a user-friendly interface.
  • Fully RTL and translation ready.

Product Size Chart Pro Features:

  • Create unlimited rows and columns for advanced size chart tables.
  • Assign pre-built size charts directly from the product edit page.
  • Multiple table design presets for stylish layouts.
  • Advanced button styling and customization options.
  • Full control over popup design and appearance.
  • Dedicated Elementor widget for size chart display.
  • Includes priority support.

WPB Product Size Chart for WooCommerce Support and Documentation:

Using this plugin is super easy as we have details online documentation for this. If you are having any issue with this plugin our expert support team always ready for you. Just open a support ticket on our support forum.
sections.installation:
• Install it as a regular WordPress plugin.
  • After installing the plugin, activate it. Then go to Dashboard > Size Charts. Configure the plugin settings and save settings.
  • After installing the plugin follow our step by step online documentation.
sections.faq:
Does WPB WooCommerce size chart plugin work with the theme that I am using?

We test this plugin with so many free and premium themes. It should work with any standard WordPress themes. If you are having any issue with your theme, please open a support ticket on our forum. We will fix the issue and release an update for this plugin.

In comparison to YITH Product Size Charts for WooCommerce, why should I use this plugin instead?

YITH is, without a doubt, an excellent add-on. To counter this, our size table generator is lightning-fast and requires no special training to operate. Developed with the help of the Vue Js modern Javascript framework.
